summary: A local cut's scoped capture is admitted for its share of the store, not a whole store-size staging allowance, so members with less scratch free no longer refuse it

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. Shared-checkpoint captures and proofs are admitted as before; the live reserve and every check made while a capture runs are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: scoped captures are charged a whole store-size allowance again.
